shortDescription: Manage the rip router attributes on AlliedWare Plus devices

options.name: network
options.description: Used to specify networks or VLANs, to which rip routing information will be sent and received.

options.name: passive_interface
options.description: Command for blocking RIP broadcasts on the interface.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the configuration values in the device's current active configuration.    When set to I(present), the values should be configured in the device active configuration and when set to I(absent) the values should not be in the device active configuration
